product: Boostrix (Tetanus Toxoid, Reduced Diphtheria Toxoid and Acellular Pertussis Vaccine, Adsorbed)

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
BOOSTRIX (Tetanus Toxoid, Reduced Diphtheria Toxoid and Acellular Pertussis Vaccine, Adsorbed) is a
noninfectious, sterile, injectable suspension for intramuscular use.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each 0.5 mL dose contains aluminum hydroxide as adjuvant (formulated to contain 0.3 mg aluminum) and
4.4 mg of sodium chloride.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each dose also contains ≤100 mcg of
residual formaldehyde and ≤100 mcg of polysorbate 80 (Tween 80).

allergens.quote:
The tip cap and rubber plunger stopper of the prefilled
syringe are not made with natural rubber latex.
Each 0.5 mL dose contains aluminum hydroxide as adjuvant (formulated to contain 0.3 mg aluminum)

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
BOOSTRIX is contraindicated in individuals with a known history of severe allergic reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to any component of BOOSTRIX or after a previous dose of any tetanus toxoid-, diphtheria
toxoid-, or pertussis antigen-containing vaccine

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote: The vial stoppers are not made with natural rubber latex.
